card.name: Start of mul- and promulgate
card.fires_on: The first pieces of words that begin with "mul" or "promul", such as Multrys, mulch and promulgate. It fires on the "mul", "ul" or "ulg" piece before the word is finished.

modes.label: promulgate
modes.description: The "ul" or "ulg" piece inside promulgate, about laws or regulations being issued.
modes.example: In Justinian's Code, prom<<ulg>>ated in 529, persons

modes.label: mulch

modes.example: Bury this vine in rich soil and cover with a little<< mul>>ch. Water well and leave it alone

modes.label: Multrys brand name
modes.description: The "Mul" piece at the start of the product name Multrys in a drug label.

card.writes: It seems to add the rest of an unfinished word, but the promoted tokens are mostly unrelated word pieces.
card.plain: It lights up on the opening letters of words like mulch, promulgate and the brand name Multrys, before the word is complete.
